name: Through A Looking Glass
source:
After a strange encounter with a hooded figure at a local fairground, you find yourself in a world of animal eared companions. Some friendlier than others, some more unnerving than others, and some that might just know how you got here in the first place.

[From [url=https://fabunny.itch.io/throughalookingglass]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在当地集市上与一个戴着兜帽的人物奇怪地相遇后，你发现自己身处一个充满动物耳朵同伴的世界。有些比其他人更友好，有些比其他人更令人不安，还有一些可能只是知道你最初是如何来到这里的。

[来自[url=https://fabunny.itch.io/throughalookingglass]itch.io[/url]]
